text: A prestige class. Draconic growth: natural armor, claws and bite, a breath weapon, ability score bonuses and wings. Seven of its ten levels advance an arcane spellcasting class. Hit Die d12, 2 + Intelligence modifier skill points a level, medium base attack bonus (3/4 of the level), good Fortitude and Will saves.
